editorial:
Imagine a world of fancy palaces and royal drama, but with a very cute twist: a mischievous corgi named Mistletoe. You will follow Prince Edmond, who is trying his best to get on his mother's good side by taking care of this royal pup. The problem is that Mistletoe is a total handful and keeps causing chaos everywhere he goes. To save the day, Edmond hires Cecily, a talented dog expert who knows exactly how to handle stubborn pets. The vibe is cozy, sweet, and perfect for a rainy afternoon when you just want something lighthearted to watch with your family.

The chemistry between the two leads is great, and the dog basically steals every scene he is in. While the plot is pretty predictable, that is exactly why it works as a holiday movie. It does not try to be a deep drama; it just wants to make you smile. It is a simple, charming flick that makes you believe in love and the power of a good dog.
endingExplained: In the end, Prince Edmond and Cecily realize they are perfect for each other. After overcoming a few misunderstandings and royal hurdles, they share a romantic kiss under the mistletoe. Mistletoe the corgi finally behaves, showing that Cecily's training worked. The movie wraps up with a big, festive Christmas celebration where the royal family accepts their relationship, proving that love can happen in the most unexpected places.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves royal romances and cute dogs.
